要求Requirements
做法Approach全部明装：线灯、筒灯直接贴顶装，不开槽、不开孔、不做吊顶；墙上不新加点all surface-mounted: linear lights and downlights fixed straight to the ceiling, no slots or cut-outs, no false ceiling; no new wall points
色温CCT2700–3000K2700–3000 K
显色CRIRa ≥ 90Ra ≥ 90
防眩Anti-glare射灯、轨道模块、筒灯都要防眩款（深杯或蜂窝网），坐着、躺着看不到灯珠spots, track modules and downlights must be anti-glare (deep-set or honeycomb), no visible LEDs when sitting or lying
调光Dimming客厅、主卧、孩子房；吊灯按自购灯的调光方式接线living, master, kids; pendant wired to suit the supplied fitting's dimming
开关Switching每个房间门口一个；客厅分轨道 / 洗墙 2 路one at each door; living on 2 circuits: track / washer
柜内插座Cabinet sockets玄关柜里加 2 个带盖插座（图上 A、B）：A 中间清洁格靠大门那半，开在柜背板上，离地约 1.05–1.13m，给手持吸尘器充电座（格里有湿拖把，用防溅款）；B 餐边格最上面一格，离地 2.4m 以上，给木工的灯带驱动（灯带开关用触摸或手扫感应，接在驱动低压那头，不另拉墙面开关）two covered sockets inside the entrance cabinet (A, B on the model): A in the cleaning bay, door-side half, on the back panel, about 1.05–1.13 m up, for the handheld vacuum dock (splash-proof: wet mop in that bay); B in the top compartment of the sideboard bay, 2.4 m up or more, for the carpenter's LED drivers (the strips switch by a touch or hand-sweep sensor on the low-voltage side, no wall switch)
柜内走线Cabinet wiring从最近的插座回路引过去，线走柜子背后（背板离墙留 20–30mm）或踢脚板后面，墙上不开槽；柜子进场前接好，木工只在背板上开孔fed from the nearest socket circuit, run behind the cabinet (20–30 mm gap behind the back panel) or behind the skirting, no wall chasing; wired before the cabinet goes in, the carpenter only cuts the holes in the back panel
合计Totals线灯约 17.1m，灯带 2.8m，轨道 3.0m，明装筒灯 1 个，阳台防水吸顶灯 2 个，吊灯安装 1 个；柜内带盖插座 2 个linear ~17.1 m, strip 2.8 m, track 3.0 m, 1 surface downlight, 2 outdoor balcony ceiling lights, 1 pendant (install only); 2 covered sockets in the cabinet
不含Not included餐桌吊灯灯具（淘宝自购，只装）、孩子房充电阅读灯 2 个（自购）、玄关天花充电感应射灯 1 个（自购，不接线）、DB 柜充电感应灯 1 条（自购，不接电）、餐边柜内灯带（木工做）the dining pendant fitting (owner-supplied, install only), 2 rechargeable reading lamps in the kids' room (bought separately), 1 rechargeable motion-sensor spot on the entrance ceiling (bought separately, no wiring), 1 rechargeable motion-sensor light in the DB cabinet (bought separately, no wiring), the strips inside the sideboard (the carpenter's)

灯具、安装分开报价；线灯、灯带按米（含驱动）。位置以现场为准。Price fittings and installation separately; linear lights and strips per metre incl. drivers. Final positions on site.
